changes: Removed the About page pronunciation label, playback control and implementation.
Wallpaper source tiles show source-specific cached image previews, the chosen gradient or the chosen solid color. Image previews include the current overlay and blur settings.
Preview loading is deduplicated, uses small disk-cached thumbnails and does not change Home, the selected source, gallery, search topic or appearance.
Page background extension uses one solid color at each edge by default. The optional Gradient extension switch restores sampled gradients.
Keep initial colors now shares the icon column, label layout and separator alignment of the other browsing display settings.
